## Why visit

One of the best ways to make the beer trip work as a food trip too. The basement setting, substantial tables and walled garden create a more relaxed meal stop than trying to eat in a tiny historic snug. It is connected to the same operators as Bridewell and Denbigh Castle, and cask remains part of the offer. Use it as the planned meal in a Hope Street afternoon, with the surrounding old pubs supplying the architectural variety before and afterwards.
